claims: Todd Golden is the current head coach of the Florida Gators men's basketball team.
Todd Golden was hired on March 18, 2022, as the 20th head coach in Florida Gators men's basketball program history.
Todd Golden was the head coach at the University of San Francisco from 2019 to 2022.
Todd Golden led the University of San Francisco to a 57–36 record.
Todd Golden led the University of San Francisco to an NCAA tournament bid.
In the 2024–25 season, Todd Golden led the Florida Gators men's basketball team to a 36–4 record.
In the 2024–25 season, Todd Golden led the Florida Gators men's basketball team to an NCAA championship.
As of November 2024, reports indicated potential Title IX inquiries involving Todd Golden, as reported by The Independent Florida Alligator.
Kelly Rae Finley was the head coach of Florida women's basketball until her departure.
Kelly Rae Finley's departure was reported in March 2026 by the Gainesville Sun
